diagnosis: Checks C3 and C4 are leaking because the model is defaulting to 'best practice' or 'proactive' settings for communication policies. In all rollouts, the decision-maker set 'after_hours_async_first_after_1600' to true (satisfying C3/PF2) and 'weekly_chairs_publish_decisions' to true (satisfying C4/PF3) as generic, helpful charter elements without having access to Sofia's specific boundary or Grant's prior promise.

C3.why: Sofia's agreed boundary changes after_hours_async_first_after_1600 from an unspecified contact rule to true for urgent requests after exactly 16:00.

C4.why: Grant's prior promise changes weekly_chairs_publish_decisions from false or unspecified to true and supplies the meeting-process element of the charter.
